# Coralite

> Coralite is a fast static site generator and compile-time Web Components framework for Node.js (>=22.22.2). Components are single .html files with templates, scoped styles, and standard named exports, compiled into zero-JS static HTML with optional client-side hydration.

## Critical Directives

Key words per RFC 2119:

1. **MUST use Named Exports**: Component `<script type="module">` blocks must declare behavior using standard top-level named exports (`export function`, `export const`). Handlers use `export function` (`server`, `client`, `onError`). Declarations use `export const` (`attributes`, `getters`, `style`, `slots`, `provide`, `consume`, `formControl`, `listStrategy`). Never author new components with `class extends HTMLElement` or legacy `defineComponent({ ... })` (retained strictly for backward compatibility).
2. **Pages use flat named exports too**: Page files (`src/pages/*.html`) use `export function server`, `export const meta`, `export const getters`, `export function client`, and so on. Legacy `export default definePage({ ... })` remains supported and is migrated by `coralite fix --migrate-pages`. Pages declare page information and default state with `export const meta` (the page analog to component `attributes`); `attributes` itself is rejected on pages.
3. **MUST author components in `.html`**: Components are single `.html` files in `src/components/<tag-name>.html` containing `<template id="<tag-name>">`, optional `<style>`, and optional `<script type="module">`.
4. **MUST keep templates dumb**: Templates support flat identifier interpolations only: `{{ propertyName }}`. Expressions, dot-notation, function calls, and inline event handlers (`onclick`) are strictly forbidden. Compute all derived logic in `getters`.
5. **MUST respect the Serialization Boundary**: `server()` runs strictly in Node.js at build time and is stripped from browser bundles. `client()` runs in the browser and cannot capture module-scope variables or static top-level imports; use dynamic `await import()` inside `client()` (including lazy dependency stylesheets via `await import('pkg/styles.css', { signal })`; static or server-side `.css` imports trigger `CORALITE-E109`).
6. **Flexible context parameters**: Context objects for `getters`, `style`, and `slots` can be destructured (`({ state }) => ...`) or accessed via a unified context parameter (`(context) => context.state...`).
7. **MUST keep `style` getters synchronous**: Style property getters receive `CoraliteStyleContext` (`{ state, isServer, signal }`) and must be synchronous (`CORALITE-E303`).
8. **MUST pass `{ signal }` to event listeners**: Always bind DOM events inside `client()` using `el.addEventListener('click', fn, { signal })` for automatic cleanup.
9. **MUST NEVER mutate state inside `observe()`**: `observe(key, cb)` is exclusively for syncing external DOM/side-effects. Mutating state inside an observer triggers `CORALITE-E302`.
10. **MUST NEVER use defensive guards in deterministic blocks**: Context keys (`state`, `refs`, `signal`, `emit`, `lists`, etc.) are guaranteed by the framework. Never write `if (!refs) return` or check `typeof window` in `client()` or `server()`.

## Core Documentation

- [Dynamic Components](/llms/components.md): Single-file HTML structure, named exports schema, attributes coercion, getters, client lifecycle, and slots.
- [Serialization Boundary](/llms/serialization.md): Server/client isolation, SSR data fetching, hydration bridge, and dynamic imports.
- [Form-Associated Custom Elements (FACE)](/llms/face.md): `formControl = true`, `setFormValue`, constraint validation, and form reset/restore lifecycles.
- [CSS Scoping & Styling](/llms/css.md): `@layer components`, `:host` & `:host-context()` selectors, dynamic style variables, lazy dependency stylesheets (`await import('*.css')`), and slot layout transparency.
- [Plugins Reference](/llms/plugins.md): `definePlugin`, two-phase context resolvers, and build/client lifecycle hooks.
- [Diagnostics & Validation](/llms/diagnostics.md): Compiler diagnostics (`CORALITE-E1xx` to `E4xx`), root causes, and automated AST fixer (`coralite fix`).
- [Configuration](/llms/config.md): `coralite.config.js`, `defineConfig` options, CSP policies, and build options.
- [Automated Testing & E2E](/llms/testing.md): Playwright locator chaining, `updateComplete` settlement, and static `data-testid` conventions.

## Full Reference

- [Complete Reference Dump](/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive single-file reference containing all APIs, schemas, and specifications for large-context models, including the built-in plugin references and the opt-in SPA router contract (§10.1 `coralite/plugins/router`: registration, outlet semantics, `autoWrap`/`outletOnly` config flags, `navigate`/`current`/`beforeEach`, navigation guards & events). The dedicated router documentation is published at [Router Plugin Reference](https://coralite.dev/docs/reference/plugins/router.html) and [SPA Router Guide](https://coralite.dev/docs/guide/spa-router.html).
